title: State Prices for Gas: U.S. Average Crosses $4 a Gallon
description:
State prices for gas are back in focus after an October 8, 2026, report put the U.S. average above $4 per gallon. We explain that national benchmark, then examine reporting on falling gas prices in states suspending fuel taxes, without assuming tax relief explains every price change. The takeaway: a national average is not your local pump price. What state are you in, and how much did you last pay per gallon?

For entertainment and informational purposes only. This is not financial, legal, medical, or other professional advice. Consult a qualified professional about your circumstances. We are not responsible for decisions or results based on this video.
